complexity_definitions.complex: The task is hard, ambiguous, or architecturally tangled: distributed behavior, races, or unclear requirements.
complexity_definitions.normal: The task is a standard development chore with clear scope.
complexity_definitions.simple: The task is small, quick, or minor: a tweak with obvious scope.
complexity_definitions.trivial: The task is a one-line change, typo, or rename-only edit.

risk_definition: The task carries production, security, billing, data-loss, or deployment blast radius if done wrong.

task_definitions.adversarial-review: Try to break this: attack the system, bypass controls, or defeat safeguards.
task_definitions.architecture: Make a system design decision: architecture, ADR, or structural trade-off.
task_definitions.ci-troubleshooting: Fix a failing CI pipeline, build, GitHub Action, or workflow.
task_definitions.code-review: Peer-review a code change: diff, PR, commit, file, or patch.
task_definitions.debugging: Something is broken, failing, or crashing: diagnose and repair the defect.
task_definitions.documentation: Write or update docs: readme, changelog, guide, or reference.
task_definitions.exploration: Read-only question about the code: find, explain, list, or summarize.
task_definitions.implementation: Write new code or change existing code: implement a feature or fix.
task_definitions.large-context-analysis: Analyze a large scope at once: whole repo, many files, or long context.
task_definitions.planning: Plan the work: spec, roadmap, breakdown, or work sequencing.
task_definitions.refactoring: Restructure code without changing behavior: refactor, migrate, rename, or clean up.
task_definitions.repository-analysis: Map or survey the repository: codebase structure, overview, or inventory.
task_definitions.second-opinion: Give an independent second opinion on a decision or approach.
task_definitions.security-review: Assess a security concern: vulnerability, CVE, injection, bypass, or hardening.
task_definitions.test-debugging: A test is failing: diagnose the failing test or suite.
task_definitions.test-generation: Write tests: generate, add coverage, or create unit tests.
